class.name: NetwChannel
class.brief_description: Sends raw bytes between peers on a numbered channel.
class.description:
Use it for data that belongs to no node, such as voice, chat or a compressed map. Channels are numbered from [code]100[/code] to [code]254[/code]. Call [method register] once on every peer. [codeblock] # both peers, once: var chat := Netw.channel(self, 120) chat.register(func(sender: int, payload: PackedByteArray) -> void: show_line(sender, payload.get_string_from_utf8()) )
# any peer, any time: chat.broadcast("gg".to_utf8_buffer()) [/codeblock]

method.name: broadcast
method.description: Sends [param payload] to every other peer.

method.name: register
method.description: Calls [param handler] as [code]handler(sender, payload)[/code] for every payload received on this channel.

method.name: send
method.description: Sends [param payload] to [param peer_id]. With [param batched], it is sent at the end of the frame together with other data, in fewer packets.
